LightningComponentBundle.description: Generates a draft Service Cloud reply via the Apologist Agent API and places it in the conversation composer for human review.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Title
property.description: Card title shown in the component header.

property.name: cardDescription
property.label: Description
property.default: Generate a draft reply from the Apologist Agent API.

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Icon name
property.description: SLDS icon in category:name format (e.g. standard:robot, utility:chat). See https://www.lightningdesignsystem.com/icons/

property.name: messageLimit
property.label: Past messages to include
property.description: Number of most recent messages to send to the Agent API. Leave blank to include the entire conversation.
